ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_amplify_are: Increases the area of effect of the ability before it.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_quicken: Skips part of the cooldown the ability before it starts. Also works on toggles and holds when the glyph turns them off.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_discount: Refunds part of the Vault mana the ability before it costs, including the drain of toggles and holds while on.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_echo: Casts the ability before it a second time. Pays its mana again, no extra cooldown. Once per spell.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_strengthen: Increases the damage dealt by the ability before it and its projectiles.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_accelerate: Makes the projectiles of the ability before it faster.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_homing: Projectiles of the ability before it seek the nearest enemy.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_orbit: Projectiles of the ability before it circle around you until they hit something.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_delay: Pauses the spell before the glyphs that follow.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_loop: Re-casts the ability before it every time its cooldown ends, paying mana and cooldown, while you cast other spells. Cast the spell again to stop. Delay glyphs at the end of the spell add a wait before each repeat.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_size_up: Makes the projectiles of the Bundled Spell or ability before it bigger, hitbox included, or the Arcane beam or Rail wider. No limit.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_size_down: Makes the projectiles of the Bundled Spell or ability before it smaller, hitbox included.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_ethereal: The projectiles of the Bundled Spell or ability before it, or the Arcane beam, pass through blocks but still hit enemies.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_shotgun: Splits the projectiles of the Bundled Spell or ability before it, or the Arcane beam or Rail, in two, 15 degrees apart, each at half damage. Stack it for more.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_low_gravity: The projectiles of the ability before it drop less. Two remove the drop.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_charge: Charges the Arcane beam or Rail before it, 1 s per glyph, then fires it. A charged Arcane starts at 10x damage, losing 1x each second, then 0.5x after 10 s; a charged Rail deals 10x.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_creative_lo: Creative mode only: casting the spell starts re-firing it every tick; cast it again to stop.
ars_nouveau.glyph_desc.vault_bundled_spe: Throws a projectile carrying the rest of the spell, which is cast where it lands.
